description_summary: Use when assessing duplicated contracts, leaky service/repository boundaries, unused dependencies, or avoidable TypeScript starter complexity.
should_trigger: Assess duplicated contracts and avoidable complexity in this starter.
Rank technical debt by current cost and change risk.
Find leaky service and repository abstractions without refactoring automatically.
Evaluate whether this repeated logic represents the same domain rule.
Identify unused dependencies and stale architecture documentation.
should_trigger_test: Explain why an intentional repository port is not needless indirection.
Prioritize evidence-backed cleanup proposals after a broad codebase assessment.
should_not_trigger: Fix this typo in one mobile component with a contained edit.
Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Diagnose this Postgres unique constraint failure in a Drizzle repository.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
